title: Not leakproof
text: Not leakproof. Found the item to be a good size for morning coffee on the run but found item definitely not leakproof and drips from around seal of cap on body. Push snap to open isn’t a very good feature also. Definitely not highly recommended.

product_metadata.title: Kamille Coffee Tumbler Stainless Steel Coffee Travel Mug - Double Wall Thermal Vacuum Insulated Coffee Cup with Lid for Cold, Ice Drinks and Hot Beverage-16oz
features: Insulated: This vacuum insulated travel mug uses the double wall method. The stainless steel keeps everything hot or cold for hours, and the metal will not sweat or become hot
Durable: Every part of the stainless steel coffee tumbler is built to last. The vacuum insulated tumbler with lid can take drops without a single dent, and the seal will remain intact
Unspillable: The stainless steel tumbler with screw on lid is spill proof. The screw top prevents leaks while the easy-to-use top allows easy drinking at the flick of a single finger
Easy to clean: The stainless steel coffee mug with lid is easy to clean. All parts of the thermal coffee mug are detachable and BPA free for easy cleaning
Compact: This stainless steel travel tumbler mug is portable and fits in car drink holders for traveling from home to office. This small profile vacuum insulated coffee mug has a 16 ounce capacity
